subject.title: [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible streaming tool calls are dropped when provider omits finish_reason

question: Should native `delta.tool_calls` plus a confirmed clean SSE `[DONE]` terminal be sufficient tool-use intent when an OpenAI-compatible provider omits `finish_reason`?
rationale: The repair is narrow but changes the provider-to-tool execution boundary, so automation should not choose that trust contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept clean-DONE promotion
options.body: Allow native tool-call deltas from a clean `[DONE]` stream to promote to `toolUse`, while keeping EOF without `[DONE]` and ambiguous recovered/text cases conservative.

options.title: Keep finish_reason required
options.body: Document that OpenAI-compatible streaming tool execution requires an explicit final finish reason and leave this provider behavior unsupported.

options.title: Require opt-in compatibility
options.body: Add a provider capability or configuration gate for no-finish tool-call promotion, accepting a new setup surface to reduce default behavior change.

recommendation.title: Accept clean-DONE promotion
recommendation.body: Allow native tool-call deltas from a clean `[DONE]` stream to promote to `toolUse`, while keeping EOF without `[DONE]` and ambiguous recovered/text cases conservative.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider-stream and release history make this the strongest available routing signal for the trust-boundary decision.
